conventions.param_offset: record offset = state_offset + 4 + 2*p (low byte; high byte follows, normally 0)
conventions.write_verified: written at the listed values via the bridge, record read back, value landed at the stated byte
conventions.address_confirmed_only: index responds and lands at the byte, but value range/semantics not exercised (usually only 0/1 written)
conventions.trailer: record byte 459 changes on every edit (checksum-like), not a param
conventions.safety: write only published ranges; out-of-range index values can wedge the pedal (Classic PS p0 = 6 did).
conventions.synced_rate: With Sync on, a rate is an 11-step division enum, stored = index x 10: 1/1=0, 1/2=10, 1/2D=20, 1/2T=30, 1/4=40, 1/4D=50, 1/4T=60, 1/8=70, 1/8D=80, 1/8T=90, 1/16=100. Screen-confirmed on Trem Jet and Shiver T; likely the same on other syncable FX3 models. With Sync off the rate is free 0-100.
conventions.editor_defined: Names, UI bounds, defaults and enum labels from official Mini algorithm_50.xml in Editor V1.6.0. Editor-defined is not live write verification. Existing live evidence wins conflicts.
conventions.range_provenance: valid_range retains prior evidence. editor_definition records editor display/internal bounds separately; valueType may transform display values. Never assume display Hz/ms equals API raw values.
